chunks: Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali, from Abd Allah ibn al-Salt, from Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from Is ibn al-Qasim, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
When the deceased dies while in a state of janabah, he is given one ghusl only; then after that, ghusl is performed.

key_terms.جُنُبٌ: in a state of janabah requiring ghusl

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a deceased person dies while in a state of janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a deceased person who dies while in a state of janabah. It indicates that a single ghusl suffices in this case, addressing funeral washing within the framework of ritual purity rulings.
